name: HZ_FINANCIAL_PROFILE
description: The HZ_FINANCIAL_PROFILE table stores information about the financial accounts owned by a party. For example, when a credit evaluation of a prospective customer is don, data such as the balance in the prospective customer's bank account would be stored in this table

columns.name: FINANCIAL_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Financial profile identifier

columns.name: ACCESS_AUTHORITY_DATE
columns.description: The date that access to the information in the account was granted

columns.name: ACCESS_AUTHORITY_GRANTED
columns.description: Indicates if access to information in a financial account was granted. Y for access has been granted. N for access has not been granted.

columns.name: BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The reported balance on an account. The balance can be a positive number, negative number, or zero.

columns.name: BALANCE_VERIFIED_ON_DATE
columns.description: The date and time that the account balance was verified

columns.name: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: An account number at an organization that identifies the account.

columns.name: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: A short name that classifies accounts. For example, savings, checking, home loan, personal loan, trading, and so on.

columns.name: FINANCIAL_ORG_TYPE
columns.description: A classification of financial organizations. For example, bank, savings and loan, private lender, building society and so on

columns.name: FINANCIAL_ORGANIZATION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the financial organization that holds the account

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique party indentifier. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
